scope: Eleven functional cases against final ZIN 01 assets, followed by nine preset-framing regressions after the CSS stage-width correction. Functional controller cases were not repeated after this layout-only correction and on-demand diagnostic addition.
assetStage: Final ZIN 01 GLB and 512-sample 1200x1000 lossless studio poster; unchanged hashes in the functional run and subsequent framing run.
browser: Chromium with ANGLE SwiftShader software WebGL; hardware GPU performance not measured.

visualReview.findings: The corrected 320px construction screenshot shows the full right temple. All nine updated preset screenshots pass both CSS clipping-boundary and actual-vertex NDC checks. Root conducts the final art-direction review.

notes: Chromium uses SwiftShader; this verifies functional rendering, not hardware GPU frame-rate performance.
document.hidden/visibilitychange is simulated by instrumentation, not a real operating-system tab-background test.
The model-loading-dispose case intentionally cancels its request and expects net::ERR_ABORTED.
Earlier concurrent-rendering timeouts are archived under output/playwright/eyewear-viewer/qa-preliminary.json; all original endpoint assertions passed in the isolated final run.
Subsequent framing regression is reported separately from the eleven earlier functional cases; no claim is made that the full controller suite was rerun after the CSS correction.

framingReview.originalIssue: The 320px construction preset had a 296px stage clipped by a 272px host.
framingReview.correction: Constrain the stage width to its host.

assertions: stage and canvas within host/clientWidth and visible viewport, tolerance 1 CSS px
all actual model geometry vertices projected through matrixWorld and the camera
near/far clip bounds and at least 3 CSS px of product margin
checks before and after each screenshot
